fix_subject: Fix: reset empty_range in the TIMESTAMP range() table function
pr_title: The TIMESTAMP/INTERVAL overload of the range() table function silently

labels.summary: The TIMESTAMP/INTERVAL range() table function never reset its reused local state's empty_range flag, so once one input row produced an empty range, all subsequent rows in a LATERAL were silently dropped; the fix resets the flag per row.
